title: Trustworthy Borehole Database Ingestion from VLM Proposals: Provenance and Spatial Support
description: Versioned Computers & Geosciences Paper 4 result-reproduction package containing the manuscript, supplementary methods, vector artwork, structured result-level inputs, claim-evidence audits, submission checks, rights/linkage sign-off, and deterministic recomputation scripts. The author sign-off supersedes earlier provisional ledger statuses only for the exact named release scope; historical run metadata remains historical. The separately released data-v002 companion has mixed source-specific terms and is not covered by a blanket licence.
